name: How do you remove smoke odor from a property?

mainEntity.name: How do you remove smoke odor from a property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smoke odor removal requires specialized techniques and equipment. This typically involves thorough cleaning of all surfaces, air scrubbing, and thermal fogging or ozone treatments to neutralize odor particles. HVAC system cleaning is also crucial to prevent re-contamination. The effectiveness depends on the extent of smoke penetration and the type of materials affected.
